4–12 Years

Growing Kids / Tweens

Recommended Use: Kids’ Personal Care Products

Why it suits 4–12: Skin barrier is stronger and sweat glands are more active. Needs effective cleansing with age-appropriate, pH-5.5 care. Formulation must be gentle but enough to remove tough germs & grime.

Simply Kids recommended for 4–12 years

13–18 Years

Teens

Recommended Use: Teen-Specific Personal Care Products

Why it suits teens: Puberty increases oil and sweat, needing balanced, barrier-safe cleansing.

Why adult products aren’t recommended: Adult formulas can be too harsh and worsen irritation or acne.

settings.text:
Simply Kids is a range of scientifically developed, pH-balanced personal care products for children aged 4–12.

Designed to address the transition phase between baby skin and adult skin, our formulations support the natural skin barrier, maintain optimal pH, and are free from unnecessary toxins and pore-clogging ingredients.

Trusted by thousands of Indian parents, Simply Kids uses clinically validated formulations with a stringent, safety-first development approach.

settings.heading: Why does their skin change at 4?

settings.text: By age 4, a child's acid mantle (skin barrier) is developing, but their oil glands are not yet fully active. This creates a unique challenge: their skin attracts dirt and pollution like an adult's, but it dries out much faster. They need a formula that removes 99% of germs and sweat without stripping away natural moisture. We engineered Simply Kids specifically for this fragile yet active developmental phase.
